newsitem.title: USA: Ira Food to change name, completes merger.
newsitem.headline: Ira Food to change name, completes merger.

text.p: Ira Food Brokers Inc said Wednesday that it approved a name change to American-International Food Corp and will be applying for AFCO.OB as its new symbol.
The company said it has completed the purchase of Servac International Inc of North Carolina, a North Carolina corporation, and Servac International Inc, of North Carolina, a Bahamian corporation.
Pursuant to the agreement, Ira Food Brokers issued 3,358,840 shares of common stock to the Servac shareholders.
Servac is in the commercial fishing business and had net sales in 1996 of about $2.2 million.
